summary: First digest since genesis week, and the busiest week the machine has had: ten campaign chains got heat and scenarios, six deep dives went to FINAL, and every one of them closed WATCH. Zero INVESTABLE, zero TOO_LATE. The best of the six, Elbit Systems on the hormuz-maritime naval-escort link, has the cleanest earnings-quality grade (A) and the deepest would-buy discount to spot (48-60%) in the book — read that one first. The week also cost the chain its own headline finding: tibet-mega-dam's global-hydro-spillover link, last week's rank-1 money corner, lost money_corner entirely on a fresh 14-page evidence re-score, and the resulting stage regression is now stuck behind a gate contradiction nobody can run their way out of. Radar and campaign stayed PAUSED on your 2026-09-01 call all week, exactly as instructed — this digest is the only routine that fired. Two things are worth knowing before you read further: `data/indicators.json` still does not exist (unchanged from last week, second week running), and this week's check_model.py run found 89 ledger lines that did not run on the required claude-sonnet-5 tier, several on claude-opus-5 and even grok-4 — directly undercutting the cost reason the routines were paused for.

blocked: hormuz-maritime: 9 of 10 tanker-bucket profiles behind ELBIT-SYSTEMS still carry at least one NULL canonical field (mostly quality.piotroski/beneish_state); TEEKAY-TANKERS and EXAIL-TECHNOLOGIES are one field each from qualifying, so the next `run profile --campaign` batch is the unblock, not a data request.

russian-diesel-ban: the chain's only screened name, INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS, blocks on the identical missing cost_of_revenue_fy field; no other profiled issuer has been screened onto this chain yet, and the chain's true money-corner link (specialty-marine-broking) has zero mapped placements at all.

tibet-mega-dam: dropped from campaign stage COMPLETE back to SCENARIOS after Tuesday's honest heat re-score emptied the chain's DEPTH-mode money-corner/UNDISCOVERED scope. validate.py and check_campaign.py now disagree about what stage the theme is allowed to hold, so it cannot re-close under the current gate regardless of what Atlas or Ember run next — this needs your method call, not another command.

munitions-replenishment and prediction-market-plumbing: both stuck on the same wall for at least the third time this week — check_map.py's audit gate demands every link_coverage row be sampled, but 2-4 links on each map were never touched by `run universe` at all (zero placements, zero searches), so no fresh-context audit can pass. Past the two-failure promotion bar in tasks/lessons.md; ripe for a gate fix.
radar and campaign: still PAUSED on your 2026-09-01 call. Today's scheduled campaign routine fire correctly stood down without touching anything. No action needed unless you want to lift the pause.

ranked.title: ESLT (Elbit Systems) — the cleanest WATCH of the week, and the newest O1
ranked.case: Promoted to O1 only this week (2026-09-04) once the foreign-filer fetch fixes cleared its last NULL fields — Piotroski 8 (STRONG), Beneish -2.473 (CLEAN), net cash rather than net debt — and the dive drew the deepest would-buy discount to spot in the whole book: $282.94-$364.23 against a $701.22 reference, 48-60% below, versus VRT's 40-45% or MYRG's 54-62%. But the red team's surviving bear case is exactly why it isn't INVESTABLE: crowdedness on this link reads 72/100 with zero of four repricing-check legs met, and Elbit's 52-week high predates the Hormuz-specific occurrence this dive is meant to price by 25 days — the stock is priced for a sector-wide rearmament re-rating, not this occurrence specifically. Worth the first read this weekend because it's the one name where the earnings-quality grade doesn't cap the verdict; nothing except the crowding argument stands between this and INVESTABLE.

ranked.title: Tibet's money corner is gone — last week's rank-1 finding reversed on fresh evidence
ranked.case: Last week's digest led with global-hydro-spillover as the chain's only money corner (impact 70/crowdedness 30/capture 65, UNDISCOVERED) built on Andritz's record backlog, flagging an unresolved internal disagreement over whether it was already discovered. This week's re-score settled it the other way: 14 pages fetched with dated URLs and verbatim excerpts (the prior blocks had none), impact fell 70→45 because China's 300GW under construction is served by the domestic duopoly the beneficiary list already names, not by Western capacity absorption, and crowdedness rose 30→50 because Andritz's own sell-side target was lifted to EUR 87 on 2026-07-31 and GEV already prints 33 analysts and 81.66% institutional ownership. verdict flipped UNDISCOVERED→EMERGING, money_corner true→false, and the chain now has no money corner at all. Six other links lost capture points on their own reported numbers in the same run (cement-materials 70→40 on a guided 2026 H1 net loss; hydro-turbines 75→68 on operating cash flow down 79.98% against orders up 15.93%). ANDR.VI's own dive (rank-5 last week's spillover thesis, now WATCH) already flags the risk this evidence confirms: three quarters of its H1 2026 order surge landed in Q1, and Q2 came in 26.7% below the same quarter of 2025. The honest read is that the chain's headline finding from genesis week did not survive its first real evidence pass.

ranked.title: VRT — the genesis chain's flagship name, still a duration bet with a thin margin of safety
ranked.case: VRT was TOO_LATE in the first draft dive and got amended to WATCH by its own red team because the 32.95% five-year implied FCF CAGR the reverse-DCF prices in is a property of the five-year convention, not the ten-year one (18.33% at 10y, inside the dive's own defensible 17.1% point estimate). This week's would-buy zone deliberately narrows to the tougher five-year convention only — $141.66 to $153.19, 40-45% below the $257.08 reference — and explicitly excludes the ten-year fair value ($234.52, only 8.8% below spot) because accepting the market's own preferred duration would make the zone spot with a haircut rather than real daylight. This is the shadow book's one live row (SHD-20260829-01): recorded at 257.08 on 2026-08-29, amended in place from a DIVE_TOO_LATE origin, not yet graded (review_at 2026-11-27).

ranked.title: MYRG — the screen's original cheap read was an FCF outlier, not a mispricing
ranked.case: The dive caught something the screen missed: MYR Group's FY2025 free cash flow of $232.195M is 2.90x its own FY2022-2025 four-year average of $80.020M, and the filed reverse-DCF that made the stock look statistically cheap used that outlier as its base. The would-buy zone rebuilds the same bisection formula on the four-year average instead — $113.44 to $136.48, versus today's $294.42 close, which demands 34.77% (5y) or 19.19% (10y) growth on the rebased base — and is tagged SPECULATIVE for exactly that reason. The surviving bear case: MYR Group is a bid-competed electrical contractor whose cash generation does not scale with its revenue (average revenue rose 63.8% between the FY2018-2021 and FY2022-2025 windows; free cash flow did not keep pace). Worth remembering next time a screen row calls out a name as cheap on a single-year reverse-DCF.

ranked.title: HUBB — a $3B debt-funded acquisition landed the same quarter as the dive
ranked.case: Hubbell's Net Debt to Total Capital moved from 28% to 52% in a single quarter on an approximately $3.0 billion, almost entirely debt-funded acquisition, and the segment absorbing it (Electrical Solutions) posted a real margin decline in the same quarter (21.5%→16.7% GAAP, 22.5%→21.2% adjusted), both verbatim from the filing. Earnings-quality grade B, not capped, but the leverage jump is why the would-buy zone ($305.30-$378.70, 8-15% below the $332.61-ish reference the dive reasoned from) sits closer to spot than VRT's or MYRG's: less room is being given for a name that just changed its own balance sheet.

ranked.title: The universe-audit wall: two campaign themes can no longer close, and it's a gate defect, not a research gap
ranked.case: check_map.py's audit gate requires every link_coverage row to appear in the fresh-context audit's sampled_checks, with no exception for a link `run universe` never touched (zero ACTIVE placements, zero recorded searches). munitions-replenishment (perchlorate-oxidizer, resolved by hand 2026-08-31) and prediction-market-plumbing (funding-and-settlement-rails, liquidity-provision, still open as of Friday's fresh-context attempt) both hit it, and prediction-market-plumbing's is now a confirmed third occurrence of the identical shape — an audit that examines everything that exists on the map still tops out at 9 of 11 links and fails on a structural gap it cannot sample its way past. This is past the two-failure promotion bar tasks/lessons.md sets for itself: either Atlas closes the two links EXHAUSTED with a real census (the cheap fix, already used three times on this same map), or the gate gets an exemption for a link nothing was ever recorded on. Both themes are otherwise ready — prediction-market-plumbing's own census work is done, munitions-replenishment has 3 completed profiles waiting on the PROFILED→SCREENED step.

Six links lost capture points on their own reported numbers. The chain now has zero money-corner links.

check_model.py found 89 findings this week: ledger lines missing a `model:` field entirely, and a cluster that ran on the wrong tier outright — claude-opus-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, claude-fable-5, claude-fable-5-1, and (unexplained) grok-4, against a required claude-sonnet-5 for run chain/heat/scenarios/universe/universe-audit/selection/deepdive/redteam. Advisory only, exits 0. Worth your attention given the pause was a cost decision.

A serious profile-integrity catch this week, already fixed: five COMPLETE issuer profiles (AMKOR-TECHNOLOGY, MICRON-TECHNOLOGY, INTEL, TSMC, ASE-TECHNOLOGY) were verbatim copies of VERTIV-HOLDINGS's data — every canonical metric, the business summary, the catalysts, even the changelog said VERTIV — and check_profile.py and validate.py both returned OK on all five, because neither gate checks that a source block's CIK or market-file path actually belongs to the profiled issuer. Repaired by hand; the gate itself is unchanged and would pass the same corruption again (tasks/backlog.md, 2026-09-01, bucket profile-gate-identity, still OPEN).
